description: Shell script for testing handling of empty current working directory during various git operations, including checkout, reset, merge, cherry-pick, rebase, revert, rm, apply, and submodule removal.

methods.name: test_incidental_dir_removal
methods.description: Tests that directory removal commands do not incidentally clean the current working directory.

methods.name: test_required_dir_removal
methods.description: Tests that directory removal commands fail when the current working directory needs to be removed.

methods.name: test_incidental_untracked_dir_removal
methods.description: Tests that untracked directory removal commands do not incidentally clean the current working directory.

methods.name: test_submodule_removal
methods.description: Tests removal of git submodules with various directory states.
